newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains down as sterling reaches new high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains down as sterling reaches new high.

text.p: LIFFE wheat eased in subdued trade as sterling hit a new record, at a six-year high against the mark at 2.9740 marks.
"Up sterling went and down we came," one trader said.

But most market players reacted to the uncertainty by sitting on their hands. Total volume on wheat was just 260 lots, with November by far the most active contract on 125 lots. It last traded 0.90 stg lower at 83.25 stg.
Barley also fell. Active November last traded 0.75 stg lower at 79.50 stg on volume of 25 of a total 36 lots.
Physical grains markets also eased in subdued trade, traders said.
